component.name: Lume TI
component.summary: Records Signal K history and an offline library of manuals on the Pi, and answers questions about both

description.p: Lume TI records the boat's Signal K data on the Pi and keeps it next to your manuals, logbook and alerts. Ask it questions in SQL or plain English from the Lume TI web app: a SQL console, a document library and an Ask tab. It also serves Signal K's History API and, optionally, Grafana over PostgreSQL.
